[center][font=Georgia][size=5]Say hello to[color=#0000ff] [color=#6d9eeb]Sydney[/color][/color], the newest resident of Pelican Town![/size][/font]

[size=4][font=Georgia]A marine biologist with a passion for science and environmentalism, she lives on the western shore of Pelican Town's beach. Having moved from her hometown, she's arrived to help assist Demetrius with his research into the Valley's local wildlife.[/font][/size]
[size=4]
---

[font=Georgia]Kind, empathetic, and dutiful, Sydney[/font]'s [font=Georgia]determined to make the Valley a better place for everyone--human, or otherwise.[/font][/size] [font=Georgia][size=4]However... despite the smiles, and behind the well-wishes, a deep melancholy also follows her.[/size][/font]
[i][font=Georgia][size=3]Who is she really?[/size][/font]


[/i][/center]
